Assess component reusability and maintainability in the provided frontend code.

Requirements:
- Follow `.github/copilot-instructions.md`.
- Apply `rules/reusability.md`, `rules/maintainability.md`, and relevant checks from `rules/scss-quality.md`.
- Evaluate naming strategy (BEM), selector depth, component coupling, and repeated patterns.
- Cite rule IDs for every finding.
- Return output in the required standard format (`Summary`, `Findings`, `Positive Notes`, optional `Suggested Refactors`).
